tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po drug cu pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i sngags rnams bzhugs so// mgon po drug cu pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i sngags dang / mchod pa/ bskul rnams phyogs gcig bsgrigs na/ gsol kha'i skabs su lha mo'i sngags ni/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo/༈ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ ma ༈ dgra bo/ mo'i 'bod pa/ che ge mo/ ma sha trun a mu ka mā ra ya ༈ gsod par gyis hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mgon pho mo'i 'bod rbad bsad gsum ni/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ mo'i rbad pa/ traka rak+sha kha mun+ta/ ru lu ru lu/ traka rak+sha/ snying khrag snying bh+yoḥ pu tra pu tra bh+yoḥ sha sha trag sha sha trag trag mo tra sa/ sha truṃ mā ra ya/ mo'i bsad pa/ ma hā rak+sha tsit+ta srog truṃ truṃ/ kā ma la rak+sha tsit+ta srog trun trun/ gu h+ya rak+sha tsit+ta srog trun trun/ tri baṃ rak+sha tsit+ta srog trun trun/ ma ma tsa rbur tsit+ta srog trun trun/ pu ru tsa lum tsit+ta srog trun trun/ haṃ shaṃ tri sha trun mā ra ya/ pho'i 'bod pa ni/ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a sho ded/ mo smugs spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ pho'i rbad pa/ dh+rīka dh+rīka ya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig dum shig ā gats+tsha/ ya nṛ ya nṛ/ mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag la 'jib dzaḥ pho'i bsad pa/ tri na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ mon bu pu tra shaṃ rbad/ yam smugs/ ling 'dus/ kham shod sa ya mo dzaḥ dgra bo'i rus la khrol khrol/ gser gyi spu gri a marbad/ haṃ shaṃ tri sha trun mā ra ya phaṭa/ 'di rnams gtso bo sa lo'i zhu dag dang / gzhan yang sngags 'chang yab sras kyi gsung rgyun deng sang bar dpal sa skya'i bde chen gling chos grwa'i ngag rgyun la 'jags pa rnams sor bzhag yin/ yang 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod la zhal gyi mtshan sngags sbyar ba sogs sa lo yab sras kyi gsung rgyun ma 'di lta ste/

bla ma dam pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab 'khyil ba/ /lbu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ /a mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gi bzhes nas kyang / /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shri mā hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra/ ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra a pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig dang ni/ /rna ba dang ni de bzhin sna/ /lce dang tsit+ta yang dag ldan/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra mahā pañca in+t+ra gu h+ya puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshil chen po/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /byin za chen pos bsregs pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin gyi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra/ ma hā me da gu h+ya dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sbrang chen po/ /sra ba ras kyi sdong bur bcas/ /yi dwags me yis sbar ba yi/ /snang gsal mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wa ra mahā ma du ra gu h+ya ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi khrag dang zhag /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag sbags/ /nus pa mchog dang rab ldan pa/ /rab tu sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di/ /dpal ldan mahā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞

/oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba sa tu ti ra gu h+ya ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus kyi/ /bza' ba khrag gi btung bar ldan/ /ri dang rgya mtsho mnyam pa yi/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan mahā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta bhu dza tha pe pa tha āḥhūm̐/ dril bu dam tshig bskul ba'i sgra/ /rnga chen kun nas brjod pa'i sgra/ /dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra/ /cang te'u phrin las bskul ba'i sgra/ /gsang ba'i rnga chung dbang sdud sgra/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa'i sgra/ /'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /rab brjid snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā gu h+ya shap+ta pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re nam mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan/ /keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan/ /phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan/ /'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan mahā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/ /dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra mahā gu h+ya a laṃ kri te pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar te/ /ye shes lnga yis byin rlabs pas/ /kha dog dri ro nus par ldan/ /dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro dang po 'du ba'i gzhi/ /gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul/

/dam tshig༞ /bcol ba'i༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā gu h+ya a mṛ ta sa mu dra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /sgron ma lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs bcas/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yi/ /bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor ni/ /mngon par byin gyis brlabs nas kyang / /dam tshig bzhin du bdag 'bul gyi/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes mdzod la/ /dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa ma hā pañca a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rgyal po rab 'phros pa/ /khro bo'i khro mo mnyes byed pa'i/ /gsang ba'i mchod gtor rim pa 'di/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas sbyar/ /chu pho khyi'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba la shing kun mkhar du bris pa'o// ༈ /yang bsgral mchod kyi skabs su mdzad pa'i dpang gzugs ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /dus gsum bla mas dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /dkon mchog gsum pos dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /dus gsum bde gshegs dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /yi dam lha tshogs dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /chos skyong srung mas dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gros dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /lha srin sde brgyad dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /yul lha gzhi bdag dpang mdzod cig /ngas ni ma nyes ma tho'o/ /'go ba'i lha rnams dpang mdzod cig /gces pa'i lha rnams dpang mdzod cig /bstan pa'i srung ma dpang mdzod cig /dpang pos mi chog grogs kyang 'chol/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs ngan pa 'dis/

/sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po bshig /dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyen po smad/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdos/ /srung ma khyod la bsdo phod btsugs/ /skye 'gro'i dbugs len thams cad byas/ /'jig rten thams cad phung du bcug /sems can rnams la 'tshe ba byas/ /las 'bras bden pa khyad du bsad/ /rnal 'byor bdag la brnyas pa byas/ /rgyu 'bras la ni mi 'dzin pa'i/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs ngan pa 'di/ /'go ba'i lha dang phral nas ni/ /da lta nyid du bsgral re ran/ /chos skyong srung ma ra mda' bzlog /phyi nang chos srung ra mda' bzlog /dam can rgya mtsho ra mda' bzlog /bstan pa'i chos skyong ra mda' bzlog /'go ba'i lha rnams ra mda' bzlog /ma g.yel ma 'da' srung ma'i tshogs/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dran nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mdzad ran/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ma bcag /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dam ma 'da'/ /dam tshig bskul lo srung ma rnams/ /dgra bgegs sgrol cig srung ma rnams/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag skya bo chod/ /sa yi rten phur nag po phyungs/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus/ /kha nas khong khrag dron mo phyungs/ /lcags kyus khug la zhags pas chings/ /lcags sgrog gis sdom dril bu yis/ /brgyal bar gyis la dbang du bsdus/ /phyes shig non cig rmugs par gyis/ /dkrugs shig g.yeng shig rengs par gyis/ /phug cig chod cig dum bur gtubs/ /ye shes me yis 'tshig par sregs/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /da lta nyid du bsad par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / /bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / /srung ma khyod la do bsdo dang / /skye 'gro dbugs len byed pa dang / /'jig rten phung du 'jug pa dang / /sems can rnams la 'tshe byed dang /

/las 'bras khyad du gsod pa dang / /rnal 'byor bdag la brnyas byed pa'i/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs ngan pa 'di'i/ /lus sems bral bar ma byas na/ /srung ma khyed rnams mthu rtsal chung / /bdag gis bcol ba'i las 'di la/ /ma g.yel srung ma mthu rtsal bskyed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa dag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis rgya gar gyi slob dpon bram ze nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa zur du bkol ba'o// ༈ /yang phyag len gyi rim pa gsar rnying rnams la mdzad pa'i drag bskul rnams ni/ hūm̐ bse mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'khor bcas rnams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig la/ /dgongs la rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul ba yi/ /bcol ba'i las la ma g.yel da chos shig /mthu stobs nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed la/ /dgra gang yin gyi ming 'jug ༈dam nyams dgra bo mi nor 'khor bcas kyis/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung rgyu 'bras rnams/ /khyad du bsad bcing sa skya'i bstan dang gdung / /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /legs par bsam pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi/ /byad kha rbod gtong mnan gzir ngan sngags dang / /gshin rje'i 'phrul 'khor rdzas ngan cho 'phrul dang / /lus kyis rdzas bsags ngag gis sngags bzlas pa/ /sems kyis dmigs pa dmod pa dor ba dang / /khyad par bdag gi chos skyong dmag zor ma/ /mthu ldan pu tra ming sring beg tse can/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor bcas dang / /gzhan yang gnas bdag gzhi bdag lha klu dang / /yul btsan rgyal po drag btsan la sogs pa/ /bskul zhing rbad dang bcol gtam gnyer gtad sogs/ /ci byas thams cad byed pa po rang la/ /bzlog ste kho rang zhag zla ma 'gyangs par/ /lus sems phrol la rnam shes dbyings su sgrol/ /snying khrag dron mo zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /dam nyams dgra bo kho rang phyogs rnams la/

/nye ba'i grogs dang mdza' bshes thams cad kyang / /myur bar phyes la dran pa nyams par gyis/ /smyo 'bog sems 'khrugs ltas ngan sna tshogs thong / /sprul pa yang sprul bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed dgra bo'i steng / /mtshon cha'i char phob nad dang sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzir bar gyis shig lha dang srung ma rnams/ /ma g.yel bcol ba'i las 'di da lta sgrubs/ /rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su da thong zhig /bcol ba'i las 'di myur du ma bsgrub na/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las 'das 'gyur bas/ /las 'di 'bad med 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /ma nyes bden tshig 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /srung ma khyod la ra mda' bos pa'i dus/ /rtags mtshan de ma thag tu ma btang na/ /lha srung chos la mnyes shing mthu rtsal kyang / /rdzun du 'gyur zhing sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /gnod pa'i dgra bo mang du 'phel 'gyur bas/ /gcig tu sgril la khros pa'i drag shul kyis/ /ming tsam med par thal bar brlag par gyis/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyang / /bdag cag slob dpon 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa dang / /mi mthun phyogs rnams nye bar rab zhi nas/ /yid la ci bsam 'bad med 'grub par mdzod/ /rtag tu 'khor dang longs spyod ldan pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra bo lha srung thams cad kyang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi srung mar 'gyur bar mdzod/ /da lan bcol ba'i las la mthu ma chung / /ma g.yel las la bskul lo grogs mdzod cig /ces chos srung rnams la drag po'i las bskul ba'i tshig 'di la sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis dgos pa'i don zhig byung bas rkyen byas 'chi med rdo rje'i gur khang du bris/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ zhal la/ hūm̐ zhing skyong stobs 'phros dbang po 'khor bcas rnams/ gzhan 'dra/ dmag zor mar/

bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas rnams/ gzhan 'dra/ las mgon la/ hūm̐ dam can mon bu pu tra 'khor bcas rnams/ gzhan 'dra/ mgon khang spyi la/ hūm̐ ma hā kā la lcam dral 'khor bcas dang / /zhal bzhi yum can dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ /dur khrod bdag po pu tra ming sring dang / /dkar bdud lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ gzhan 'dra/ zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyi dgos don khyad par can zhig byung bas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ /hūm̐ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gis/ /srog gi snying po phul nas dam bcas pa/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gtso bo dpal ldan nag po che/ /lcam dral dran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas/ /rnam 'phrul du mas hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrogs shing / /ha ha'i gad rgyang srid gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ /ro ru ro zhes gdug pa'i khrag rgyun gsol/ /mā ra'i sgra 'byin gsod la brtson rnams kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /bstan la gnod byed gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dam bca' ji bzhin myur du mngon par khug /grih+ṇa bhan+dhas bzung zhing bcings nas ni/ /ha na da has bsnun cing bsdigs par mdzod/ /pa tsa pa tsas bsregs bcad gtubs nas ni/ /mā ra ma ras myur du bsgral ba yi/ /sha khrag las grub mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/ /kha kha khā his legs par btab pa yis/ /rang gi sha gcod brtul shugs bzlog nas ni/ /dam nyams snying khrag dbugs la myur du rol/ /gzhan yang 'khu byed gtor ma'i las brtsam gyis/ /kha 'jam sems gdug rang gi phyogs 'dzin cing / /bu ltar gces pa'i gsang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ /myur du tshar gcod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /'di bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad// ༈ /bh+yoḥgason cig 'dod khams gtso mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /mnyes byed 'dod yon rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/

/khyod kyi thugs dam gnyen po skong gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /lus ngag yid la bar du gcod pa yi/ /gdon bgegs nad rims la sogs 'gal rkyen gyi/ /nyer 'tshe ma lus mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun du gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin rnams kyang sku tshe legs brtan zhing / /sku gsung thugs kyi bar chad nyer zhi nas/ /phrin las phyogs rnams kun tu rgyas par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang gzhan yang bdag nyid la/ /phan par sems pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang dbang phyug dang / /snyan grags 'byor pa rab tu rgyas par mdzod/ /'dzam bu gling dang nye ba'i yul 'khor gyi/ /rgyal po g.yog 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /de la 'go ba'i lha srung nye ba'i tshogs/ /ma lus bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /bdag gi 'khor du gnas pa thams cad kyang / /phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang rab ldan zhing / /nga rgyal 'gran sems phrag dog rnams zhi nas/ /rtse gcig chos bzhin sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang 'khor du gnas pa'i tshul ston zhing / /rtag tu dge la bar chad byed pa yi/ /dam nyams gsang ba'i dgra bgegs gang yin rnams/ /dus kun sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /bdag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa yi/ /ngan sngags zor kha gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor dang / /gzhan gyi rbod gtong byed pa gang yin rnams/ /de nyid de la bzlog cing sgrol bar mdzod/ /khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig byed cing / /bla ma la sdang sems can kun la 'tshe/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag byang chub sgrubs pa la/ /bar du gcod byed phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla gar gnas kyang / /khyod kyi mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed la/ /ma thogs skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir khug

/bsrung skyobs byed pa'i lha srung kun dang phrol/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun rnams dang phye bar gyis/ /smyo 'bog sems 'khrugs ltas ngan sna tshogs thong / /sprul pa yang sprul bye ba'i tshogs spros la/ /bskrad gzir bcings shing dbye dang mnan pa dang / /rmugs shing dran pa nyams par byas nas kyang / /da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig /sha khrag rus pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo rol/ /don snying rnam lnga 'khor bcas zhal du gsol/ /yan lag mgo sogs chod la rgyan du gyis/ /dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum dgra bgegs rnams/ /bdag gis gtad do gnyer ro thugs dam can/ /le lo btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /sdang sems dgra bgegs 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /khengs pa'i nang nas srog rtsa dmar po phyung / /ltag pa'i phyogs nas bdud rtsa nag po chod/ /gdong gi phyogs nas 'od dang mdongs phrogs shing / /gnam gyi 'ju thag dkar po steng nas chod/ /sa yi rten phur nag po 'og nas phyung / /gshin rje'i khram dang bdud kyi shwa la thob/ /mgo lus yan lag srog gsum dum bur gtub/ /kha nas khong khrag dron mo skyugs nas kyang / /da lta nyid du bsad cing bsgral bar mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /tshe ring nad med 'dod don kun 'grub cing / /longs spyod 'khor sogs ma lus dbang du bsdus/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /mi 'bral khyed kyis sdong grogs mdzad nas kyang / /byang chub lam sna zin pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /'di ni zhal snga nas blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gso'i nang nas drag po'i bskul zur du bkol ba yin no// ༈ /zhal bzhi pa'i drag bskul ni/ hūm̐ chos skyong stobs 'phrog nag po da tshur nyon/ /srung ma bram ze'i gzugs can da tshur nyon/ /sha za sring mo bzhi po da tshur nyon/ /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi lcam dral khyod/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i ring nas khyod bsten no/

/slob dpon brgyud dang bcas pas khyod bsten no/ /bdag gis gus pa'i tshul gyis khyod bsten no/ /gtor ma ri ltar spungs nas khyod bsgrub bo/ /do nub khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /spyir gyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa dang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra byed pa dang / /sems can yongs la 'tshe ba byed pa sogs/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu nag po khyod kyis sgrol/ /sgrub po bdag gi ma nyes gzugs gnas kyang / /sdig can dgra bos nyes pa tshur la brkos/ /mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer/ /bdag la mi min chos la chos min zer/ /yid la brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di/ /lo zla yun ring bzhag pa'i longs med pas/ /da lta dngos su khug la bsgral bar mdzod/ /nga nyid ma nyes yus kyis brnangs ba yis/ /srung ma khyod la ra mda' bos pa na/ /'di la da lta dngos su rtags phyungs shig /'di la da lta rtags mtshan ma byung na/ /khyod nyid mthu rtsal myur ba rdzun du nges/ /thog ser me dbal bcas pa 'di la rgyob/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'di la thong / /glo snying dmar po phyung la zhal du gsol/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul mi rung sna tshogs thong / /'di yi sha rus zhal du chom chom gsol/ /snying khrag dron mo hub kyis 'thung bar gyis/ /mdor na rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /da res bcol ba'i phrin las ma bsgrubs na/ /khyod kyis thub pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dang / /pha mes brgyud pa'i dam las 'gal gyur bas/ /de bas da res bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /phrin las srung ma khyod kyis 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di sngags 'chang shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i zhal gyi bskang gso'i nang nas drag po'i bskul zur du bkol ba'o// ༈ /pu tra'i drag bskul ni/ hūm̐ dam can mon bu pu tra khyod/ /bka' yi las mkhan mthu rtsal can/ /dpa' bo bdud 'joms dgra srog gcod/ /khro gtum rngam pa khyod la bstod/

/ging chen nag po bha ṭa ni/ /mthing nag stag gi slog pa gyon/ /dom shing dgra bgegs snying la 'debs/ /sgrol byed bdud po khyod la bstod/ /mon mo kha nas me 'bar ma/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /gtum chen 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog /gsod byed nag mo khyod la bstod/ /kun kyang mi sdug cha byad can/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /rngam zhing gsod pa'i las la brtson/ /'khor dang bcas pa dgra la bh+yo/ dam can ming sring mthu rtsal can/ /da ni chos shig dmag la chos/ /dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs la/ /dam nyams cham la phob las shog /khyod kyi g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa'i tshogs/ /btsan dang gshin rje'i dmag tshogs kyi/ /dmag sna drongs shig dgra la bh+yoḥ khyod kyi g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa/ dge slong 'khar gsil thogs pa brgya/ /rgyal po the'u rang dmag tshogs kyi/ /dmag sna drongs shig dgra la bh+yoḥ khyod kyi slad nas rjes 'brangs pa/ /sngags nag phur zor 'phen pa brgya/ /drag po gza' dang bdud dmag gi /dmag sna drongs shig dgra la bh+yoḥ /khyod kyi gshegs kyi shul 'dren pa/ /bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya/ /sha za ma mo'i dmag tshogs kyi/ /dmag sna drongs shig dgra la bh+yoḥ /gzhan yang dam can 'khor gyi tshogs/ /mon pa pho mo a tsa ra/ /ma mo sha za srin mo sogs/ /thams cad mi sdug cha byad can/ /rngams shing gsod pa'i las la brtson/ /zhal nas 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs/ /mchongs zhing lding zhing rgyug 'dral byed/ /la la glo snying dmar po bza'/ /la la mi rkang gling bu 'bud/ /'ga' zhig zhing chen g.yab mo rdeb/ /la la zhags pa nag po thogs/ /la la bsur chen dud pa gtong / /'di tsam tshad du ma nges te/ /las mkhan pho nya bsam mi khyab/ /'ur 'ur chems chems stong gsum khengs/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /chos shig chos shig dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/

/dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs shig /ltas ngan cho 'phrul de ru phob/ /nad kha rims kha dgra la bh+yoḥ /'go ba'i lha dang phrol la shog /snying dang dbang po phyungs la shog /mgo dang yan lag phrol la shog /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /thal ba rdul du brlag par gyis/ /dus la bab bo mthu ma chung / /dus la bab bo rtsal ma zhan/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /'di bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad// ༈ /zor lam dbye ba 'phags pas mdzad pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag lus rdo rje 'chang dpal gyi/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal nyid kyi bka'/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams/ /dam tshig rgyan gyis mdzes byas shing / /rim gnyis ting 'dzin brtan byas te/ /bzlas brjod sngags kyi pha rol son/ de phyir sngags 'chang 'od stong ldan/ /phrin las rnam bzhis mkha' la rgyu/ /dgra bgegs steng nas skam pa'i phyir/ /gtor zor drag po'i pho nya 'gyed/ /dbang po byin za gshin rje dang / /srin po chu bdag rlung lha dang / /nor lha dbang ldan la sogs pa/ /bdag gi grogs mdzod zor lam phye/ /zor 'phangs phyogs dang nye ba na/ /yul lha'i rigs dang chu mig rdo/ /shing dang sa la gnas pa yi/ /'byung po thams cad sku zur cig /don gnyer gang zhig phyogs su 'gro/ /lam du zhugs dang mkha' la rgyu/ /dgra bgegs ma gtogs 'gro ba rnams/ /rang rang phyogs su sku zur cig /bzung bar 'dod la skyod ma nus/ /brtan par gnas pa'i sa bdag sogs/ /ma 'jigs ko long ma sdom par/ /mtho bar gnas pa zhabs bsdogs la/ /dma' bar gnas pa dbu chum zhig /bag yang gnas pa bsgrims nas su/ /na bza'i mtha' dang zhabs skums shig /srid gsum gzhom par 'dod pa yi/ /mthu stobs drag po'i shugs ldan 'di/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la 'phen/ /ma rungs dam nyams dgra bo 'dis/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa ba bshig

/sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams par byas/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i bar du gcod/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde ba bcom/ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i thugs dkrugs shing / /dpal ldan bla ma'i dgrar gyur 'di/ /sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs gtor nas/ /snying khrag zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ ༈ /pho nya bskul ba sa lo yab sras kyi gsung rgyun ma ni/ dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang / /lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyi/ /steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /khyung chen sngon po lding zhing 'khor/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥde ni dgra la bh+yoḥ /chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /dpal 'bar ma hā༞ /lha chen dpal༞ /g.yas nas sprul༞ /bya nag mang po 'phur zhing lding / /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /dpal 'bar༞ /lha chen༞ /g.yon nas༞ /khyi nag mang po 'khang zhing zug /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /dpal 'bar༞ /lha chen༞ /rgyab nas༞ /ce spyang mang po g.yal zhing rgyug /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /dpal 'bar༞ /lha chen༞ /mdun nas༞ /mi nag mang po 'o dod 'bod/ /bh+yo bh+yo༞ /chos chos༞ /dmag dpung༞ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog/ //ces dpal sa skya pa'i man ngag mgon po drug cu pa la nye bar mkho ba'i sngags dang mchod pa bskul rnams phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'di sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sa lo yab sras kyi zhabs 'degs su dmigs nas sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ mgon po drug cu pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i sngags rnams/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
